newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says wider forex band will help economy.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says wider forex band will help economy.

text.p: Indonesia's State Secretary Murdiono said on Monday that the central bank's widening of its dollar-rupiah intervention band would strengthen the economy, and warned that attacks on the currency were bound to fail.
"Our economic fundamentals are strong. The decision to widen the intervention band will make the economy even stronger," he told reporters.
"What we decided on Friday is a precautionary step. We are aware of attacks from everyhwere, but any speculation on the rupiah will fail," Murdiono said.

Bank Indonesia, the central bank, surprised the market on Friday by widening the dollar-rupiah band to 12 percent from eight percent following recent de facto devaluations of the Philippine peso and the Thai baht.
The move helped the rupiah strengthen briefly to 2,410.0 to the dollar on Friday but it gave up ground to close at 2,438.0.
The Indonesian rupiah was on a roller-coaster again on Monday morning, rattled by continued speculative attacks on other regional currencies.
Currency dealers said the rupiah was not a direct target of fund managers but was affected by the attacks on the Malaysian ringgit and the Philippine peso.
Spot rupiah weakened to an intra-day low of 2,469.0 per dollar on Monday morning from an opening of 2,453.0 before it recovered to 2,445.0 and settled at 2,455.0 around midday.
